prompt: CSS text-3 Chinese writing system assumed ISO script codes
answer:
CSS Text 3 treats these ISO script codes as indicating the **Chinese writing system**:

- `Hant`
- `Hans`
- `Hani`
- `Hanb`
- `Bopo`

It also assumes the Chinese writing system when the content language is Chinese and no script is specified. Source: [CSS Text 3 Appendix F](https://w3org.cn/TR/css-text-3/).
